description: Create a new outreach campaign in one go, the dashboard's 'Criar com um clique'. Without sheetId it follows the onboarding's steps with no questions (the best campaign that does not repeat the workspace's, its first 10 people found and saved in a new sheet, billed like any search, and its cadence), and leaves it as a draft to review and activate; it reports its phases while it works. The result's why says which campaign was chosen and why; it does not repeat the workspace's campaigns, it is a first look at 10 people (more come later), and the cadence is written and waits for review. When sheetId is set, it drafts name, offering, goal, CTA and cadence from the workspace profile plus the instruction and attaches people from that people sheet after the draft (rowIds left out means every row, up to 1000). The sheet is only the audience list unless useSheetContext is true (a list of founders does not turn the campaign into a founder campaign); a campaign from a sheet claims no buying signal the request did not state, and is named after the sheet. Its channels follow what the list can receive (LinkedIn connections have no e-mail: a LinkedIn-only campaign); channels sets them explicitly ("no LinkedIn" = ["linkedin"]). channels ["whatsapp"] makes a cadence of WhatsApp only (steps the seller sends from the phone, or WhatsApp automático where the workspace sends it), and only people with a mobile enter; on a company sheet its quote then includes each person's mobile (phoneLookup: the company's WhatsApp do decisor first, 6 credits, else the person's mobile, 20, each only when found). Suited to creating a campaign from an existing sheet or to offering a demo. A COMPANY sheet works the same as sheetId, with no separate decision-maker step: the same sheet becomes the campaign's people, the decision makers of each company take its place, each row keeping the company's columns; a company where nobody is found stays, marked, out of the campaign. For a company sheet the first call only quotes (status needs_confirmation, with maxCredits for the first batch of up to 25 people) and spends nothing; a call with acceptedCredits equal to that maxCredits runs it. The other companies are converted by the campaign itself, a few a day, once it is active. areasNote, when present, flags people who may not fit; they can come out of the list or stay with that version ("Tirar da lista" on the campaign's Template tab). templateId is not accepted.When people of the campaign still wait on their sheet row's e-mail, LinkedIn or phone lookup, enrichmentPending counts them by field and enrichmentPendingNote is a short sentence saying so; the address joins the campaign by itself when the lookup finishes.

acceptedCredits.description: Only for a company sheet, on the second call: the maxCredits the first call returned, after the user agreed.

channels.description: Channels the user asked for; ["whatsapp"] for WhatsApp only. Omit to use the ones the sheet's people can receive.

decisionMakers.description: Only for a company sheet: whom to write to at each company. Omit to use the account's persona.

jobTitles.description: Short job titles to look for: the user's ("diretor de marketing"), else 3 to 6 from the account's persona.

targetProfile.description: A ready profile when the user named a function, not titles; owners for small businesses.

instruction.description: What the campaign should sell or ask for, e.g. offer a Nock demo.

rowIds.description: Optional subset. Omit to attach every people row in the sheet.

sheetId.description: Sheet UUID: a people sheet (its people) or a company sheet (its decision makers). Leave it out to find the people.

useSheetContext.description: When true, use roles/companies from the sheet to form the campaign targeting. Default false: the sheet is only the audience and must not change the campaign slice.
